# Association Neuro-Odyssée

## Identity
- Name: Association Neuro-Odyssée
- Person: Roland Crettaz
- URL: https://www.neuro-odyssee.com
- Language: French (primary), English, German, Italian
- Location: Saint-Maurice, Valais, Switzerland

## Project
Roland Crettaz walks 1,900 km from Saint-Maurice (Switzerland) to Santiago de Compostela to rebuild himself after a late ADHD diagnosis and addictions. The journey is a live neuroplasticity experiment combining intensive walking, neuroscience, nutrition, and coaching.

## Mission
Prove that the brain can rewire itself through long-distance walking. Document the biological and psychological transformation in real time, and offer a coaching model based on personal experience.

## Services
- Neuroscience-based coaching (ADHD, addictions, burnout)
- Corporate keynote speaking on mental resilience and neuroplasticity
- Sponsorship packages for companies aligned with well-being and sport
- Online club (Le Club Neuro-Odyssée) for followers and supporters

## Route
Saint-Maurice (VS) → Lausanne (Via Francigena) → Geneva (Via Jacobi) → Le Puy-en-Velay → Conques → Cahors → Figeac → Saint-Jean-Pied-de-Port → Pamplona → Burgos → León → Santiago de Compostela

## Key Facts
- Distance: 1,900 km
- Duration: ~6 months
- Condition treated: ADHD (diagnosed at 40+), addictions, burnout
- Scientific basis: BDNF production, neuroplasticity, dopamine regulation
- Book: "Voyage au cœur de la résilience" by Roland Crettaz (December 2025)
